question.text: If for a matrix $A,|A|=6$ and adj $A=\left[\begin{array}{ccc}1 & -2, & 4 \\ 4 & 1 & 1 \\ -1 & k & 0\end{array}\right]$, then $k$ is equal to

solution.text: $\begin{aligned} & \text {  } A \cdot(\operatorname{adj} A)=|A| I \\ & \Rightarrow|A||\operatorname{adj} A|=|A|^3 \Rightarrow|\operatorname{adj} A|=|A|^2 \\ & -1((-2-4)-K(1-16)=36 \Rightarrow 6-K+16 K=36 \\ & \Rightarrow 15 K=30 \Rightarrow K=2\end{aligned}$
